method: Each move is the token's price change relative to Bitcoin over the same days, from CoinGecko daily prices at 00:00 UTC (day 0 is the unlock date, so its price is from before the unlock). Grades use the same rules as the live page, with size, trading volume and circulating supply taken from CoinGecko as they were the day before each unlock. Monthly tranches of the same token overlap: the 30 days before one unlock include the 14 days after the previous one. 'Beyond normal' compares each unlock's three weeks (7 days before to 14 after) with the token's own average three-week drift against Bitcoin over the whole year, so a token that slides all year is not blamed on its unlock. For tokens that unlock every month that average already contains unlocks, so this measure understates their effect. Ranges are 90% bootstrap ranges for the median.
